Durch die vollständige Kontrolle über die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette, einschließlich der hauseigen entwickelten Technologie, bietet Rohlik ein herausragendes Kundenerlebnis sowie die frischesten Lebensmittel von lokalen Landwirten und Manufakturen neben einer breiten Auswahl an Supermarktprodukten. Deine Rolle Als Techniker:in bist du für die Instandhaltung und Zuverlässigkeit der technischen Anlagen und der Infrastruktur unseres Lagers verantwortlich. Du führst vorbeugende und korrektive Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen durch, um Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren. Du stellst die Einhaltung der Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Arbeitsschutzstandards bei allen Facility-Aktivitäten sicher. Du unterstützt bei Anlageninspektionen, der Dokumentation und der technischen Berichterstattung. Du bringst dich aktiv in kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahm

jobs.description: Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands. Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations. You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development. The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. jobs.description: Why Design at Langfuse Your work will shape how engineers build with AI. Langfuse is often the primary interface engineers use to debug, evaluate, and improve their LLM applications. The designs you ship will be used for hours each day by thousands of developers and non-developers. They'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community Slack channels. Everything we build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. The design challenges here are genuinely hard. You need to make both the setup and the daily use feel intuitive and easy. You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. Deeply understanding the problems our users solve will make you a better designer and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. You will grow at Langfuse by Owning our product design end-to-end. You'll be the first dedicated designer at Langfuse. You'll set the standard for how Langfuse looks and feels. Making data-dense interfaces intuitive. Langfuse surfaces traces, scores, costs, latencies, token counts, prompt versions, and evaluation results. jobs.title: Sales Excellence Manager
jobs.description: As a Sales Excellence Manager (m/w/d), you will find where our sales funnel leaks and where we engage customers too slowly, then work with the sales teams until it is fixed across our global markets. You will own revenue per worked hour as our core productivity KPI, run capacity planning and bonus governance, and set the build priorities that turn your findings into tools. jobs.title: Campaign Coordinator Intern
jobs.description: As a Campaign Coordinator Intern (m/w/d), you will own the end-to-end coordination of marketing campaigns across global markets, moving them from brief to launch while keeping creative, performance, CRM, e-commerce, product and local market teams aligned. You will act as the connecting point between everyone involved, tracking dependencies, chasing inputs, and making sure each stakeholder knows what is due, when, and from whom. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how large-scale campaigns are built and shipped, with a clear path to grow into a campaign or project management position as you develop. PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets. What You'll Do - Coordinate campaigns end to end across creative, performance, CRM, e-commerce, product and local market teams, managing request intake, the production calendar, briefs, timelines and approvals. - Coordinate localisation across markets by briefing translators and local teams, tracking translation status, and making sure localised assets go live correctly and on time. - Own asset repositories and DAM hygiene, including naming conventions, folder structures, versioning, metadata, and archiving of outdated assets. - Manage campaign trackers and boards (e.g. Jira), keeping status visible and flagging risks or blockers early. - Run and document campaign kick-offs, check-ins and retros, follow up on action items, support vendor and freelancer coordination, and propose process improvements that make delivery faster and more scalable. What You'll Bring - Strong organisational skills and the ability to keep multiple moving parts, deadlines and stakeholders on track at once. - Clear, structured communication in English, comfortable chasing inputs and keeping teams aligned

jobs.title: Senior AI Content Producer - Foto, Video, Motion (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Bei Rosental Organics bist du kein klassischer Fotograf oder Videograf – du bist der Content Multiplier. Ein Shoot wird bei dir zu 50+ Assets, ein UGC-Clip zu 30 Hook-Variants, ein Produktfoto zu 20 Format-Adaptionen. Der Meta-Algorithmus belohnt Volumen und Diversität, und genau das lieferst du: aus einer Kampagne wird bei dir ein ganzer Wochen-Feed für Paid Social. Du produzierst und multiplizierst Foto-, Video- und Motion-Content für Paid Ads, Social, CRM und E-Commerce, mit klarem Fokus auf Performance und Testing-Volumen. Du drehst und shootest schnell und hands-on mit modernem Setup: UGC, Product, Lifestyle, Studio – End-to-End und ohne Assistenz-Kette. Einen skalierbaren AI-Workflow baust du selbst auf, der Rohmaterial in Dutzende testbare Variants verwandelt: Hook-Iterations, Cutdowns, Format-Adaptions, Kontext-Wechsel, Voiceover-Varianten, Motion-Loops. Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Meta, TikTok und CRM mit Fokus auf Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR und ROAS. Mindestens 3 neue AI-Tools pro Jahr integrierst du produktiv in unseren Stack (Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, Topaz, CapCut AI, Descript – was heute liefert, ersetzt du morgen). Performance-Dashboards liest du selbst, ziehst die Insights und übersetzt sie am gleichen Tag in neue Variants und Hypothesen. Du bringst 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Content Production für D2C/ E-Commerce, Performance Marketing oder ein hochdynamisches Growth-Umfeld mit, inklusive starker Paid-Social-Cases (Meta, TikTok). Dein Portfolio zeigt echte Performance-Ergebnisse (Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR, ROAS) und Beispiele, wie du aus einem Asset viele gemacht hast, keine Editorial-Reels, keine Behance-Moodboards. Neue AI-Tools lernst du eigenständig und schnell: Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Descript und Topaz sind dir vertraut, und den nächsten Tool-Sprung hast du meist schon selbst identifiziert. Du drehst, shootest und schneidest selbst (≥ 85 %): Sony/Canon, Studio-Light und Natural-Light, Premiere

jobs.title: Das Gesicht unserer Brand auf TikTok
jobs.description: Manche Dinge muss man nicht erklären. TRIONE ist eine Luxury Lifestyle Brand für Accessoires und Schmuck, designed in Marbella. Japanische Seidenkordel, graviertes Gold, Details, die man erst auf den zweiten Blick entdeckt und dann nicht mehr vergisst. Unser ONE Armband ist kein Accessoire, es ist ein Statement für Menschen, die nicht laut sein müssen, um gesehen zu werden. Jetzt bringen wir TRIONE auf TikTok. Nicht mit Countdowns und Rabattcodes, sondern mit Ästhetik, Haltung und Geschichten. Mit Videos und ausgewählten Livestreams aus unserem eigenen Store, von unseren Events und von Orten, die so besonders sind wie unsere Pieces. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unsere Welt vor der Kamera spürbar macht. Deine Rolle Du bist das Gesicht von TRIONE auf TikTok, in Videos und in Livestreams aus unserem Store, von exklusiven Events und luxuriösen Locations Du erzählst die Geschichten hinter unseren Pieces, nicht ihre Preise Du gestaltest mit uns Content, der sich anfühlt wie die Brand selbst: ruhig, ästhetisch, selbstbewusst Du bist dabei, wenn eine Brand ihre nächste Ebene erreicht Was dich ausmacht Natürliche Präsenz vor der Kamera Ein Auge für Ästhetik, Fashion und Details Du verstehst TikTok und weißt, was Menschen wirklich innehalten lässt Stil, Verlässlichkeit und sehr gutes Deutsch Was dich erwartet Sichtbarkeit als Gesicht einer Brand, die man nicht übersieht Einladungen zu unseren exklusiven Events und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk aus Creatorn und Partnern Pieces aus unserer Kollektion Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege und echter Einfluss auf das, was entsteht Flexible Zeiten neben Uni oder Job Für wen Diese Stelle ist als Pflichtpraktikum ausgeschrieben und richtet sich an Studierende, die laut Studien- oder Prüfungsordnung ihrer Hochschule ein Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren müssen. Da es sich um ein gesetzlich geregeltes Pflichtpraktikum handelt, ist keine Vergütung vorgesehen. Dafür bekommst du Pieces aus unserer Kollektion, Zugang zu unseren Events und eine Praktik

jobs.title: Full Stack Flutter Engineer – PHP/Go (m/f/x)
jobs.description: Your mission About SIDES Restaurants are where people come together over good food. We build the technology that keeps them running. SIDES is the operating system for hospitality: POS, payments, delivery, kitchen tools, self-order terminals, apps and webshops on one platform. Thousands of restaurants run on it and millions of transactions flow through it every month, peaking on a Friday night when nothing is allowed to fail. We have the owner's and the chef's back, so they can focus on their food and their guests. And it is not just code on a screen: our software runs on real hardware in real restaurants, from POS devices to self-order terminals and more. We love AI. These are wild times for software engineers, and we want to make the most of them: AI is part of every workflow at SIDES, and we are looking for people who are as excited about that as we are. Everyone on the team uses tools like Claude every day to write and review code, explore unfamiliar parts of the codebase, write tests and get from idea to shipped feature faster. We see it as a way to spend less time on boilerplate and more on what matters: good architecture, sound decisions and software that holds up on a busy Friday night. Nobody has figured all of this out yet. We experiment, share what works, drop what doesn't, and keep raising the bar together. Our tech stack: Flutter (mobile & web), Go, PHP, and AWS Your responsibilities Deliver features end-to-end in a cross-functional team, from ideation and design to implementation, rollout and operations Work across the entire stack, building Flutter experiences for iOS, Android, the web and self-order terminals, alongside Go and PHP backend services Use AI tools such as Claude in your daily work and help the team improve how it works with them Ensure operational quality through performance, security, reliability, scalability and observability, keeping ordering experiences running smoothly during peak service Contribute to architectural and design decisi

jobs.description: THE POSITION Our roster has an opening with your name on it Much of what decides whether a fan stays with FanDuel happens either side of the bet: the sign-up that takes a minute, the deposit that clears first time on a Sunday afternoon, the withdrawal that lands when we said it would, and the protections that work quietly in the background for the people who need them. We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to shape the technical direction of the systems behind that experience across FanDuel’s Customer Product Engineering (CPE) domain. CPE builds the systems fans touch first and trust most: payments and money movement, account and onboarding, geolocation, responsible gaming and player integrity, and the promotions, rewards and loyalty, campaign orchestration, personalisation and marketing messaging that shape every fan’s day-to-day experience. When CPE works, nobody notices. When it does not, a fan cannot get in, get funded, get paid or get looked after, and quality elsewhere in the product does not make up for it. The mission: make it quick and predictable for every fan to join, fund an account, get paid and be protected, in every jurisdiction we operate in, on the busiest day of the sporting calendar. Making every moment more, for our customers. Your work always follows our principle Everything Begins with the Customer. That means designing for extreme, event-driven peak load, where traffic arrives in seconds, and for a heavily regulated environment in which auditability and evidence matter as much as availability. It also means depending on other people’s systems: payment providers, identity and KYC vendors, geolocation suppliers. You build so that their bad day does not become our customers’ bad day. This is a senior individual contributor role, at the same level as our Software Engineering Directors. You'll design and build iwoca's new ledger platform – the distributed system that records every movement of money, starting with the business credit card and moving on to loans. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Ledger Platform team is rebuilding all of iwoca’s ledgers as one platform, starting with the ledger for the business credit card. Every card payment, loan repayment, and payout will end up there. Finance, Accounting, and Capital Markets rely on that record, so it has to be right every time. The team is small – a principal engineer who leads it, a staff engineer, another engineer, and you. It works closely with the product teams that build on its ledgers, and with Finance. The role You'll lead projects from design to production, and decide with product what the team builds and how. With the principal engineer, you'll design the platform's service boundaries and the APIs and event streams other teams build on. jobs.description: Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare! Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams. What you'll do We are looking for a Staff AI Software Engineer to join the AI Evaluation team (EvalX) at Doctolib and help every AI product team measure, understand and improve the quality, reliability and safety of their systems. Our AI products span patient-facing conversational agents, AI-powered phone assistants and clinical assistants supporting healthcare professionals. EvalX builds the platform, tools and methods that let these teams evaluate continuously, and our ambition is to make evaluation a core engineering practice. In this role, you will work at the intersection of platform engineering, applied AI and product teams: you build shared evaluation capabilities, and you work directly with the teams that use them so they actually get adopted. jobs.description: Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? You’ll contribute practical field insights back to the organization, helping refine solution patterns, reusable assets, and implementation playbooks. Unlike traditional software engineers who build a single product for many customers, FDEs ship tailored solutions directly in customer environments, making the platform real for specific business processes and systems. You’ll operate with increasing independence, drive execution on well-defined workstreams , and collaborate with senior FDEs and product teams to align with broader technical direction. jobs.title: Founding sales lead
jobs.description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them. We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk. ⚡ What is at stake in the coming months Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators. Deploy and sign our first paid pilots. Sign our first contracts. By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows. 🎯 Your mission Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy. Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts. jobs.description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. Overview We are expanding our optomechanical capabilities, and the success of our projects depends on optical designs that are precise, manufacturable, and verified through rigorous analysis and testing. As a Senior Optical Design Engineer, you will own optical designs from concept through lab validation, turning requirements into lens designs and optical assemblies that perform reliably in the real world. This position is central to our mission of delivering cutting-edge free-space optical systems for space applications, and it will support successful pre-production runs and strong collaboration with our suppliers. This position reports to our Responsible Engineer, Optical Systems, and is based in our Toulouse, France office. Our working language is English. What you will be doing Design and optimize lenses and optical systems, from first-order layout to detailed optimization with ray tracing and physical optics propagation (POP). Nous recherchons une personne passionnée, ayant de l’expérience dans l’installation de pompes à chaleur et/ou systèmes de chauffage et désireuse de nous aider à développer cette activité en France. Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Pourquoi ce poste ? Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e Senior Financial Accountant (comptable senior) capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables. Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 Explore your future career 🔭 We are looking for a Research Data Scientist to take ownership of Marketplace Economics and Public Thought Leadership within our specialized Research team, reporting directly to Marc Palyart (Director of ML). Working alongside two Machine Learning Researchers, you will be Malt's go to expert in applied economics and causal inference. You will combine rigorous econometric methods with a pragmatic, product and business oriented mind modeling two-sided marketplace dynamics (liquidity, fee elasticity, supply-demand balance, search frictions) to directly improve product conversion. Some of the questions you might explore : - How is the freelancing market evolving in time ? What drives supply and demand in freelance markets, and how do workers and companies respond to changing economic conditions? - What makes a market place efficient and what are the frictions that prevent beneficial matches ? How to solve these frictions ? - How do prices, platform fees, and supply and demand elasticities shape marketplace dynamics and participants' behavior? Key responsibilities ✨ Marketplace Economics : Investigate the economic mechanisms driving marketplace dynamics, supply-demand imbalances, liquidity, pricing elasticity, and matching efficiency. Applied Causal Inference & Experimentation

jobs.title: DFT Engineer
jobs.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden. Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com. Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit. Nach einer intensiven internen Einarbeitungsphase (Vormontage und Anlagenmontage) unterstützen Sie unser Team als erfahrener Field Engineer. jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution

jobs.description: Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on. You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it. Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets. Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones. jobs.title: Stage Consumentengedrag
jobs.description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je

jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer (Orbital Launch)
jobs.description: Lead Systems Engineer We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to act as the Systems Technical Authority for our orbital rocket programme. You will lead the vehicle-level systems effort, maintaining a coherent technical view of the complete vehicle and leading the definition, management, and resolution of system interfaces. Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Act as the Systems Technical Authority for the orbital rocket programme, providing vehicle-level systems leadership and maintaining technical coherence across the complete vehicle. jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Job Description Checkout.com is actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Payments Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Payments Team to drive rapid growth across various industries for our revolutionary online payment solution. If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of success selling direct payment solutions to enterprise companies, in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivaled uncapped recurring commissions plan, hybrid work model and competitive benefits package. The Senior Sales Manager will play a key role in growing Checkout.com ’s payments footprint. They will be responsible for selling Checkout.com ’s full payments technology stack to middle market and large enterprise organizations. Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business. The role As a Senior Software Engineer, you own a product area – e.g. bookkeeping, payroll or client onboarding – and take it from problem to production. We are past the founding phase but still very early: most of what you touch is greenfield. APIs, data models and services: Design and build the backend your area runs on – and ship the UI on top. jobs.title: Senior Compliance Manager & Information Security Officer (ISO) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Become a Part of Accurids Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our pharma customers rely on us, so information security and data protection are central to how we work. That is why we are ISO 27001 certified. As we grow with our pharma customers, we are creating a dedicated role for compliance. You will own our compliance programme, act as our Information Security Officer and become the central contact for security, privacy and contract obligations. How you’ll make an impact: In your first year, you take over as our ISO, lead our ISO 27001 recertification in 2027 and get us ready for SOC 2. As our ISO, you run and develop our ISMS according to ISO 27001. You own internal GDPR topics such as records of processing, data processing agreements, data subject requests and privacy reviews. You track the security, privacy and compliance obligations in our customer contracts and make sure we stay compliant. You plan and lead internal and external audits and answer customer security questionnaires. You run risk assessments, maintain policies and lead the response to security incidents. You raise security awareness across the team through trainings and clear guidelines. What helps you succeed: At least 3 years of experience in information security, ideally in a SaaS or software company. Hands-on experience running an ISO 27001 ISMS, including certification or surveillance audits. You work independently, set priorities on your own and enjoy taking ownership and improving how things work. You explain requirements in a way that engineers, management and customers understand. You live in Germany within commuting distance of Cologne and have a valid work permit. Business-fluent English and German. It’s a plus if you have SOC 2 or data protection (GDPR) experience, hold a certification such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or CISSP, or know the requirements of pharma customers (GxP). Why you’ll love

jobs.title: Marketing Chief at United Media
jobs.description: Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Marketing Chief. About us United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. To this date, we have organically launched six companies and acquired one. What we offer you As our Marketing Chief, you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You'll be working in-person in our HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with: The opportunity of having a real impact - You'll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business. Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company. Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. Market-competitive compensation. Travel opportunity: You will be joining our conferences overseas. Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training. Your Responsibilities Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around: Team Leadership: Manage and mentor the marketing team, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. Set clear goals and expectations and evaluate team performance regularly. Recruiter and onboard your team. Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with sales, product development, and other teams to ensure alignment of marketing strategies

jobs.title: Senior Media Relations Manager
jobs.description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building. If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here. About the role Let s get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: You would own Mews relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day. You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vinted Go
jobs.description: Brief info about Vinted  Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania s first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we ve grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.  Information about the position  Vinted Go is the delivery arm of Vinted, focused on developing products and solutions for seamless shipping and delivery across Europe and the US. Our delivery network includes more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO), thousands of delivery drivers and cutting-edge sorting tech. Our product portfolio spans mobile apps, IoT devices, and autonomous robots. We operate right where high-scale software meets physical hardware, storefront partner operations, and complex logistics. jobs.title: Testeur QA / Recette fonctionnelle (H/F) – Mission à mi-temps - FREELANCE
jobs.description: ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un testeur QA fonctionnel (H/F) pour une mission de 6 mois à mi-temps . Vous interviendrez sur plusieurs projets d’évolution du système d’information, dans un environnement principalement Microsoft. Votre rôle sera de valider les applications avant leur mise en production, de la préparation des tests à la vérification des corrections. Modalités de la mission Démarrage — Dès que possible Durée — 6 mois Rythme — Mi-temps, avec une répartition des jours à convenir Localisation — Région de Marseille, avec possibilité de travailler à distance TJM — À proposer Vos missions Analyser les besoins métiers et les spécifications, identifier les parcours à tester et définir la stratégie de test de chaque projet. Concevoir les scénarios, les cas de test et les jeux de données. Préparer et maintenir les plans de test. Exécuter les tests fonctionnels, d’intégration, de non-régression et de bout en bout. Participer aux campagnes de recette avant les mises en production. Qualifier et documenter les anomalies, suivre leur correction avec les développeurs et effectuer les contre-tests. Prioriser les campagnes entre les projets, communiquer les résultats aux équipes métiers et techniques et contribuer à harmoniser les pratiques de test. Profil recherché Vous avez une expérience significative en tests logiciels ou en recette fonctionnelle d’applications web ou de systèmes d’information d’entreprise. Vous savez mener une campagne de test en autonomie, documenter vos résultats et gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Vous avez utilisé Azure DevOps, Jira ou un outil équivalent, dans un environnement Agile/Scrum ou en cycle en V. Une expérience sur Power Platform, Dynamics 365 ou SharePoint , la certification ISTQB Foundation et la pratique de l’ automatisation des tests sont appréciées. jobs.title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London. This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
